name: Vofsi
title: Father of the spy Nahbi from the tribe of Naphtali
summary: Vofsi is known from the Bible as the father of Nahbi, one of the twelve spies whom Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan. He belonged to the tribe of Naphtali. Beyond this, the Bible gives no further information about his life or deeds.

keyEvents.title: Nahbi, son of Vofsi, chosen as a spy
keyEvents.description: Nahbi, son of Vofsi, was chosen as the representative for the tribe of Naphtali among the twelve spies whom Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Twelve Spies Are Sent Out
keyEvents.description: Moses sent twelve men, one from each tribe, to spy out the land of Canaan at the Lord's command. Nahbi, son of Vofsi, was among them.

keyEvents.title: Return and Report of the Spies
keyEvents.description: After forty days, the spies returned and reported on the land. Ten of the twelve, likely including Nahbi, gave a negative and discouraging message about the inhabitants of the land.

keyEvents.title: The People's Rebellion and God's Judgment
keyEvents.description: As a result of the negative spy report, the people lost heart and rebelled against Moses and Aaron. God judged that generation to wander in the wilderness for forty years.
